findings.title: ApiReturnedApplicantReminder omitted from msg_triggered_policy_reaccept allowlist (bulk sibling ApiReturnedReminder is listed)
findings.detail: A policy-reaccept 428 from the new endpoint falls through `_ -> False`, so the landlord gets an error toast instead of the reaccept modal. Inconsistent with the bulk sibling; policy bumps mid-session are the exact case the allowlist exists for.
findings.recommended_fix: Add `ApiReturnedApplicantReminder(Error(e)) -> check(e)` beside the existing ApiReturnedReminder arm.

findings.title: handle_remind_applicant copy-pastes ~110 lines of handle_remind_applicants' scaffolding (transaction body, spawn, response, error arms) instead of sharing a core
findings.detail: Only the two mark calls differ (extra email arg); everything else is character-identical. Drift risk on the load-bearing stamp+send contract: a future atomicity/response change must be hand-synced twice. Mirror is exact today.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract a private shared transaction core taking the two stamp functions (or a stamp closure) plus a shared spawn+respond tail; both handlers call it.

findings.title: Per-applicant endpoint's request-validation 400 branches (require_json, decode, empty email, invalid email) have zero test coverage
findings.detail: Every handler-level test passes a valid email; the four new validation branches are exercised zero times. P1 contract matrix ~87.5% (6/8 scenarios pinned; applied-exclusion transitive via shared bulk SQL).
findings.recommended_fix: Add integration cases: empty email, invalid email (e.g. 'not-an-email'), and missing/malformed JSON body; assert 400 for each.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.detail: P0 happy paths 100% (stage1/stage2/scoping/row-gating/404s/re-enquiry all pinned). P1 at ~87.5%: only the BAD_BODY validation branches untested, holding the gate under the 90% PASS line.
findings.recommended_fix: Cover the BAD_BODY 400 branches (empty/invalid email, malformed JSON) to lift P1 >= 90% and clear the gate.

findings.title: Awaiting-refetch-on-remind block duplicated verbatim between bulk and per-applicant response handlers
findings.detail: Same `case model.vacancy_detail { Success(detail) -> ... fetch_awaiting ... }` refetch-or-keep block in both reminder handlers. AGENTS.md DRY rule: extract at 2+ repeats.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract a private `refetch_awaiting(model)` helper returning #(awaiting_list, Effect) and call it from both success handlers.

rejected_findings.title: Generated sql.gleam comment rewrap for clear_reminder_for_sender with no matching .sql change in the diff
rejected_findings.reason: False positive. The .sql source (clear_reminder_for_sender.sql) already carries the rewrapped comment on origin/develop (commit 7bb5824, merged before this PR's base baa3e9b); develop's generated sql.gleam was stale. This PR's run_squirrel.sh legitimately regenerated sql.gleam to match the source. Source and generated file agree at the reviewed sha; regeneration is idempotent — no hand-editing, no future churn.

verdict.justification: Zero blockers. The per-applicant endpoint is a faithful, gate-respecting mirror of the bulk path: identical transaction (stamp → validate → un-stamp → commit), identical owner/closed-vacancy 404s, per-sender SQL is the bulk WHERE plus one email predicate, and the view's transaction-stable cadence gate provably suppresses stage-2 in the same transaction where stage-1 stamps (re-enquiry edge pinned by test). Four warnings (policy-reaccept allowlist omission, handler-scaffolding duplication, untested 400 branches, advisory gate CONCERNS) and one note are non-blocking.
